title: An implementer becomes a role reference where the role is already the expected type
purpose: Builtin role parameters (contains, index_of), Maybe<Role> and find() fallbacks, branches under a declared role and action results wrap implementers; comparisons go through role-typed operands.

provenance.expected_basis: Owner decision on #299: implicit role.wrap only where the target role is established by the surrounding contract — builtin parameters like action parameters, typed fallbacks, declared results and branches.
